# USHomeBuy

> USHomeBuy is a regional direct cash home buyer serving Washington DC, Maryland, Virginia, and Delaware. We provide fair as-is cash offers to homeowners facing foreclosure, probate/inherited property, major structural repairs, problem tenants, or fast relocations with zero commissions and flexible closing dates.

## Core Information
- [How It Works](https://www.ushomebuy.com/how-it-works): Explanation of our transparent 4-step as-is cash purchase process and offer formula.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.ushomebuy.com/faq): Answers regarding closing costs, timelines, as-is condition, probate, and foreclosure relief.
- [Get Cash Offer](https://www.ushomebuy.com/get-offer): Direct intake form to request a no-obligation cash offer in 24-48 hours.
- [Where We Buy](https://www.ushomebuy.com/locations): Full directory of covered markets across DC, Maryland, Virginia, and Delaware.
- [About Us](https://www.ushomebuy.com/about): Dedicated local acquisition teams with transparent, zero-commission cash offers.

## Distressed Property Situations
- [Avoid Foreclosure](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/avoid-foreclosure): Foreclosure timelines, pre-foreclosure sales, and protecting home equity before auction.
- [Inherited & Probate Houses](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/inherited-house): Selling inherited property during probate without cleaning, cleanouts, or repairs.
- [Fire Damaged Homes](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/fire-damaged-house): Selling fire, smoke, and water damaged houses as-is for cash in MD, VA, and DE.
- [Houses Needing Major Repairs](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/house-needs-repairs): Selling homes with foundation issues, code violations, or deferred maintenance.
- [Tired Landlords](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/tired-landlord): Selling tenant-occupied rental properties, dealing with TOPA and non-paying tenants.
- [Military & Job Relocation](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/relocating): Fast PCS closings coordinated to military and work report dates.
- [Divorce Sales](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/divorce): Neutral cash sales providing clean equity splits for divorcing couples.
- [Senior Downsizing](https://www.ushomebuy.com/situations/downsizing): Transitioning seniors to assisted living without renovations or estate sales.
